title: MANAGE_DATA fails with MANAGE_DATA_LOW_RESERVE
pattern: A transaction whose MANAGE_DATA operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (low_reserve). A new data entry from an account at its minimum balance; another account pays the fee.

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
